job.purpose: HBM v15 die: per-PC REAL memory controller leaf (owner 10-14 all on-chip execution real): actual ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc sequencer + same-row FIFO32 + 32 reserved responses in a real 128x256 SRAM; the stack g_pc body verbatim. 128 instances (32/stack) in the PC band boxes between the PHY-only abstract ot_hbm3e_phy_rc_e8p5 (S face) and the SM service groups (N face, K port). Flow control k_rdy/kr_rdy is the HBM-stack boundary (owner 10-14). Clock: the HBM controller clock hbm (CK/2 = 1.024 ns, the r14 timing basis; asynchronous to stream via the group FIFOs); the flow signs off at the die 833.333 ps (stricter than the 1024 ps it runs at). OREG=1: every PHY-side command output from a flop.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid, kr_rdy only pops it). Flow pin registers would add a cycle inside the elastic K ready/valid handshake (HBM-stack boundary, owner 10-14) and overflow the skids. Remaining unregistered inputs: kr_rdy (skid pop, 1-2 levels), dram_rvalid/dram_rdata (PHY return into the response SRAM write port, the modelled off-chip boundary).
